allow: Bash(pwsh -NoProfile -Command '$hasErrors = $false; Get-ChildItem -Path . -Filter "*.ps1" -Recurse | ForEach-Object { $e = $null; [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile\($_.FullName, [ref]$null, [ref]$e\); if \($e\) { $hasErrors = $true; $e | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "ERROR: $\($_.Extent.File\):$\($_.Extent.StartLineNumber\) - $\($_.Message\)" } } }; if \(-not $hasErrors\) { Write-Output "All scripts pass syntax validation." }')
